'''October 2001 Greeley tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Digital Dungeon, Greeley, Colorado on 12 October 2001. [[Tom Kathman]] won it. It is known from Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3063">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-18-greeley-10-12-01-dirty-popd3063/ greeley-10-12-01-dirty-pop], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 18 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-18-greeley-10-12-01-dirty-popd3063/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Digital Dungeon, Greeley, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Tom Kathman]]
